context.zh: 將封宮臣十六人五等子男，姚贊諫曰：「東宮文武，自當有守忠之誠，未有赫然之效，何受封之多乎？」
context.idiomatic: Hong proposed making sixteen palace officers viscounts or barons. Yao Zan objected, “Surely the crown prince’s civil and military officers owe him loyalty as a matter of duty. They have shown no conspicuous merit. Why grant them so many fiefs?”
context.literal: He was about to enfeoff sixteen palace officials as viscounts and barons in the five grades of nobility. Yao Zan remonstrated, “The Eastern Palace’s civil and military officers naturally owe it faithful loyalty. They have yet to show conspicuous merit. Why should they receive so many grants of fiefs?”

context.zh: 元子遭家不造，與宮臣同此百憂，獨享其福，得不愧於心乎！」
context.idiomatic: I, Yuanzi, have seen my house struck by misfortune. My palace officers shared all these troubles with me. Could I enjoy the good fortune alone without feeling ashamed?”
context.literal: Yuanzi meets the house in misfortune, sharing every worry with palace officials—how could he alone enjoy the blessing without shame in heart!"

context.zh: 并州、定陽、貳城胡數萬落叛泓，入於平陽，攻立義姚成都於匈奴堡，推匈奴曹弘為大單于，所在殘掠。
context.idiomatic: Several tens of thousands of Hu households from Bingzhou, Dingyang and Ercheng rebelled against Hong. They entered Pingyang, attacked General Yao Chengdu, who held the title Liyi, at the Xiongnu fort, and proclaimed Cao Hong of the Xiongnu grand shanyu. Everywhere they went they ravaged and plundered.
context.literal: Several tens of thousands of Hu households from Bingzhou, Dingyang and Ercheng rebelled against Hong. They entered Pingyang, attacked General Yao Chengdu, who held the title Liyi, at the Xiongnu fort, and proclaimed Cao Hong of the Xiongnu grand shanyu. Everywhere they went they ravaged and plundered.

context.zh: 征東姚懿自蒲阪討弘，戰於平陽，大破之，執弘，送于長安，徙其豪右萬五千落於雍州。
context.idiomatic: Yao Yi, General Who Conquers the East, marched from Puban against Cao Hong, routed him at Pingyang, captured him and sent him to Chang’an. Yi resettled fifteen thousand leading households in Yongzhou.
context.literal: General Who Conquers the East Yao Yi set out from Puban against Cao Hong. He fought at Pingyang, routed Hong, captured him and sent him to Chang’an. He transferred fifteen thousand of their leading households to Yongzhou.

context.zh: 征東姚懿自蒲阪討弘，戰於平陽，大破之，執弘，送于長安，徙其豪右萬五千落於雍州。

context.zh: 泓遣後將軍姚平救之，盛引退。
context.idiomatic: Yao Hong sent Rear General Yao Ping to relieve Qinzhou, and Yang Sheng withdrew.
context.literal: Hong sent Rear General Yao Ping to rescue him; Sheng withdrew.

context.zh: 秦州地震者三十二，殷殷有聲者八，山崩舍壞，咸以為不祥。
context.idiomatic: Qinzhou suffered thirty-two earthquakes, eight accompanied by rumbling. Mountains collapsed and houses fell. Everyone took these as ill omens.
context.literal: In Qinzhou there were thirty-two earthquakes with rumbling sound in eight cases; mountains collapsed and houses ruined—all thought it inauspicious.

context.zh: 赫連勃勃攻陷陰密，執秦州刺史姚軍都，坑將士五千餘人。
context.idiomatic: Helian Bobo stormed Yinmi, captured Yao Jundu, inspector of Qinzhou, and buried alive more than five thousand officers and men.
context.literal: Helian Bobo attacked and took Yinmi, seized Qinzhou Inspector Yao Jundu, and buried alive more than five thousand officers and soldiers.

context.zh: 勃勃既克陰密，進兵侵雍，嶺北雜戶悉奔五將山。
context.idiomatic: After taking Yinmi, Bobo advanced on Yong. The mixed households north of the ridge all fled to Five Generals Mountain.
context.literal: Once Bobo had taken Yinmi, he advanced troops to invade Yong; north-of-the-ridge miscellaneous households all fled to Five-General Mountain.

context.zh: 征北姚恢棄安定，率戶五千奔新平，安定人胡儼、華韜等率眾距恢，恢單騎歸長安。
context.idiomatic: Yao Hui, General Who Conquers the North, abandoned Anding and fled toward Xinping with five thousand households. Hu Yan, Hua Tao and others from Anding led their followers against him, and Hui returned to Chang’an alone on horseback.
context.literal: General Who Conquers the North Yao Hui abandoned Anding, led five thousand households to flee to Xinping; Anding men Hu Yan and Hua Tao led hosts to block Hui; Hui alone on horseback returned to Chang'an.

context.zh: 軍次橫水，勃勃退保安定，胡儼閉門距之，殺鮮卑數千人，據安定以降。
context.idiomatic: Shao’s army halted at Hengshui. Bobo fell back toward Anding, hoping to hold it, but Hu Yan shut the gates against him, killed several thousand Xianbei and surrendered Anding to Qin.
context.literal: The army halted at Hengshui; Bobo withdrew to guard Anding; Hu Yan closed the gate to block him, killed several thousand Xianbei, and occupied Anding to surrender.

context.zh: 軍次橫水，勃勃退保安定，胡儼閉門距之，殺鮮卑數千人，據安定以降。

context.zh: 紹進兵躡勃勃，戰於馬鞍阪，敗之，追至朝那，不及而還。
context.idiomatic: Yao Shao pressed after Bobo, defeated him at Ma’an Slope and pursued him as far as Chaona. Unable to overtake him, Shao returned.
context.literal: Yao Shao pressed after Bobo, defeated him at Ma’an Slope and pursued him as far as Chaona. Unable to overtake him, Shao returned.

context.zh: 平陽氐苟渴聚眾千餘，據五丈原以叛，遣鎮遠姚萬、恢武姚難討之，為渴所敗。
context.idiomatic: Gou Ke, a Di man of Pingyang, gathered more than a thousand men and occupied Wuzhangyuan in revolt. Yao Hong sent Yao Wan, General Who Guards the Distant Lands, and Yao Nan, General Who Restores Might, against him. Gou Ke defeated them.
context.literal: Pingyang Di Gou Ke gathered more than a thousand, occupied Wuzhangyuan in revolt; he sent General Who Guards the Distance Yao Wan and General Who Restores Might Yao Nan to campaign against him, and they were defeated by Ke.
